title: About this project
name: NASA Starboard — Abandoned, But Not Forgotten
purpose: A child-friendly archive connecting Apollo 11, Viking 1 and Sojourner with original NASA evidence and the stories of equipment left behind.

audioTerms: The owner confirms paid-plan production for Suno and ElevenLabs. Their service terms apply to those recordings; they are separate from the project's code license.

archives.name: NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA)
archives.use: Spacecraft catalog records, mission history and equipment status.

archives.name: NASA Science, NASA History and JPL
archives.use: Mission accounts and original photographs. Each exhibit links its evidence and image credits.

archives.name: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS)
archives.use: Measured Viking pressure data and documented mission context. No synthetic measurements are presented.

archives.name: NASA 3D Resources
archives.use: Original Apollo and Viking models credited to NASA / Michael D. Carbajal. Viewing colors and lighting are adjusted; educational Sojourner and Pathfinder reconstructions are project-authored.

archives.name: NASA/JPL — On a Mission
archives.use: First Steps: Sojourner podcast excerpts and transcripts in the cassette, separately credited from synthetic narration.

software: Three.js (MIT), Draco (Apache-2.0), FFmpeg for media processing, esbuild for the viewer bundle and Playwright for browser checks. Patrick Hand, Kalam and Share Tech Mono fonts use the SIL Open Font License.
license: Apache-2.0 covers project-authored code. NASA evidence, original models, fonts, supplied media and generated recordings retain their own credits and applicable terms.
distinction: Illustrated scenes and smiling characters are creative guides, not historical photographs. Real NASA images, measurements and recordings are credited individually. This is an independent team project, not a NASA product or endorsement.
